capabilities: Validate algebraic equivalence between consecutive lines of an align block
Highlight incorrect lines with red wavy underlines and uncertain lines with orange dashed underlines
Show hover tooltips explaining errors or uncertainties
Suggest next derivation steps when typing \\ at the end of a block
Check algebraic equivalence offline using mathjs
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX editor or renderer; it only verifies and completes derivations already written in align blocks.
extras: When AI validation or autocomplete is enabled, the content of the align block being validated is sent to the configured API endpoint; both features can be disabled for fully local operation.
problem: Obsidian renders LaTeX math but does not verify whether the algebraic steps in a derivation are actually correct or help continue a derivation.

relations.evidence: algebraic equivalence is checked first with mathjs, so basic errors are caught without any API call
powered by any Claude or OpenAI-compatible API
Claude or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Ollama, OpenAI, local models)

requires.name: Anthropic Claude or OpenAI-compatible API key

summary: LaTeX derivation checker that validates steps in align blocks with offline algebraic checks and optional AI error explanations and next-step suggestions.
